description: Disconnect this client from the current Vaaya account: revokes this connection's authorization server-side, so every later call fails with 401 until the user reconnects. Call it when the user asks to log out, sign out, disconnect, or switch Vaaya accounts — then relay the returned switch steps VERBATIM (the browser sign-out step is what actually enables switching accounts).
name: vaaya_logout

logged_out.description: True when the authorization was revoked.

message.description: What happened — relay to the user.

to_switch_account.description: Exact steps to reconnect with a different account — relay verbatim.

title: Disconnect / Switch Vaaya Account
